name: patina
description: Track which lines of a codebase you've read, when, and whether they've changed since.

commands.title: Mark Lines as Attend To Next
Re-check All Marks Against Current File Contents

enumDescriptions: Green → yellow → gray for read, red for stale, blue/purple categories.
Soft, low-contrast tones that stay out of the way.
Barely-there tints, close to gray; for when the marks should stay in the background.
Okabe–Ito colors: blue → sky → gray for read, vermillion for stale; no red/green distinctions.
patina.palette.markdownDescription: Built-in color palette. Each palette has translucent background colors and stronger gutter-bar colors. Any color setting you set yourself (`#patina.read.fadeColors#`, `#patina.stale.color#`, category `color`/`gutterColor`, and their gutter versions) overrides the palette.

patina.categories.markdownDescription: Static mark categories (everything except the special `read` category). Keys are category ids; each value has an optional `label`, and optional `color` (background) and `gutterColor` (gutter bar) — any CSS color, e.g. `rgba(255, 150, 0, 0.22)`. Without colors, a category uses the palette's color (custom categories get the palette's extra colors in order). If only `color` is set, the gutter uses a more opaque version of it. Bind a key to a custom category with the `patina.mark` command and `"args": { "category": "<id>" }`.

patina.read.label.markdownDescription: Display label for the read category. Category labels are set in `#patina.categories#`.

patina.read.fadeColors.markdownDescription: Background colors a `read` mark fades through as it ages, from just-read to fully faded, evenly spaced over `#patina.read.fadeDays#`. Example: `["rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.22)", "rgba(210, 180, 40, 0.18)", "rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.12)"]`. Leave empty to use the palette's colors.

patina.read.gutterFadeColors.markdownDescription: Gutter-bar fade colors for `read` marks. If empty but `#patina.read.fadeColors#` is set, a more opaque version of those is used. Leave empty to use the palette's colors.

patina.read.fadeDays.description: Days for a read mark to fade from the first to the last fade color.

patina.edited.label.description: Display label for lines read by typing on them.

patina.stale.label.markdownDescription: Display label for stale lines (changed outside the editor), used in the hover, the explorer tooltip and the `{staleLabel}` placeholder of `#patina.annotations.format#`.

patina.stale.color.markdownDescription: Background color for stale marks (lines changed outside the editor), e.g. `rgba(230, 60, 60, 0.28)`. Leave empty to use the palette's colors.

patina.stale.gutterColor.markdownDescription: Gutter-bar color for stale marks. If empty but `#patina.stale.color#` is set, a more opaque version of it is used. Leave empty to use the palette's colors.

patina.annotations.cursorLine.markdownDescription: Show a faint end-of-line note with mark info on the cursor line. The text comes from `#patina.annotations.format#`.

patina.annotations.staleLines.markdownDescription: Show the end-of-line note on every stale line (changed outside the editor), not just the cursor line. The text comes from the `stale` entry of `#patina.annotations.format#`.

default.stale: ⚠ changed outside editor {staleAge} ago · was last {label|lower} {age} ago

edited.description: Lines read by typing on them.

category.description: Lines in any static category without a template of its own.

patina.annotations.format.markdownDescription:
Text of end-of-line notes (`#patina.annotations.cursorLine#`, `#patina.annotations.staleLines#`) for each kind of mark: `read`, `edited` (read by typing), `stale` (changed outside the editor) and `category` (any static category). Add a category id as a key, such as `question`, to give that category its own text. Missing keys keep their defaults, and an empty string hides the note for that kind.

Each value is a string, or a list of segments joined with ` · `. A segment is left out when any placeholder in it has nothing to report.

Placeholders:
- `{label}`: the mark's label, such as `Read`, `Edited` or `Question` (see `#patina.read.label#`, `#patina.edited.label#` and `#patina.categories#`)
- `{age}`, `{date}`: when the line was marked, such as `5h` or `2026-11-04 14:30`
- `{faded}`: how far a read mark has faded, in percent
- `{staleLabel}`: `#patina.stale.label#` (stale only)
- `{staleAge}`, `{staleDate}`: when the change outside the editor was detected (stale only)
- `{removed}`: marked lines deleted next to this one (stale only); `{removed:line}` adds the word, pluralised

Add `|lower`, `|upper` or `|capitalize` to change a placeholder's case: `was last {label|lower} {age} ago` gives `was last read 5h ago`.

enumDescriptions: On the first line of every folded block.
Only when the cursor is on the first line of a folded block.
patina.fold.summary.markdownDescription: Show a faint end-of-line summary of the marks inside a folded block (how much is read, edited, stale or in each category) on the block's first line. It replaces the first line's own end-of-line note. Blocks smaller than `#patina.fold.summaryMinLines#`, and parameter lists (see `#patina.fold.parameterLists#`), show it only while the cursor is on their first line. The text comes from `#patina.fold.summaryFormat#`.

readAge.description: How long ago the block's lines were read.

staleAge.description: How long ago the most recent change outside the editor was detected.

patina.fold.summaryFormat.markdownDescription:
Segments of the folded-block summary, joined with ` · ` in this order: `read`, `readAge`, `edited`, `categories`, `stale`, `staleAge`, then any keys you add. Set a segment to an empty string to hide it. Keys you leave out keep their defaults. A segment is left out when any placeholder in it has nothing to report (a count of zero, or an age with no lines to measure).

Placeholders (counts are of non-blank lines; ages look like `5m`, `3h`, `2d`):
- `{lines}`, `{read}`, `{unread}`, `{readPercent}`: lines in the block, read lines (including lines you typed), unread lines, read percentage
- `{readAge}`, `{readNewest}`, `{readOldest}`: average, most recent and oldest read age
- `{edited}`, `{editedAge}`, `{editedNewest}`: lines you typed on, their average and most recent age
- `{stale}`, `{staleNewest}`: lines changed outside the editor, most recent detection age
- `{categories}`: counts per category, e.g. `2 Question, 1 Attend to next`; `{cat.<id>}`: count for one category, e.g. `{cat.question}`

Write `{name:word}` on a count to add a pluralised word: `{edited:line}` gives `1 line` or `14 lines`. Add `|lower`, `|upper` or `|capitalize` to change the case, such as `{categories|lower}`.

patina.fold.highlight.markdownDescription: While a block is folded, highlight its first line with the average color of all non-blank lines in the block, the first line included. Read lines add their fade color, stale lines the stale color (weighted by `#patina.fold.staleWeight#`), category lines their category color, and unmarked lines nothing, so a mostly unread block gets a faint tint and even a few stale lines pull it toward the stale color.

patina.fold.summaryMinLines.markdownDescription: Folded blocks that hide fewer lines than this (such as a short argument list) show their summary only while the cursor is on their first line. They still get the blended highlight.

patina.fold.parameterLists.markdownDescription: Treat folded parameter lists of function and method definitions like any other block. When off, they're treated like blocks smaller than `#patina.fold.summaryMinLines#`: the summary shows only while the cursor is on their first line. A fold counts as a parameter list when its first line ends inside an open `(` and the language reports a function, method or constructor named on that line (this needs the language's extension to provide document symbols).

patina.fold.staleWeight.markdownDescription: How many lines each stale line counts as in a folded block's blended highlight (`#patina.fold.highlight#`), so a few stale lines make the folded line stand out. `1` weighs every line equally.

enumDescriptions: Draw a colored bar in the gutter, just left of the line numbers (shares the column with breakpoints; needs editor.glyphMargin).
Gutter bar plus the background tint.

patina.showInOverviewRuler.description: Show marks in the scrollbar overview ruler.

patina.explorer.enabled.description: Show ✓ on fully read files and ! on files with stale lines in the file explorer.

patina.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for files and folders Patina should never track, such as generated files and debug logs. A pattern that matches a folder excludes everything in it. Examples: `logs`, `**/*.log`, `tmp/debug`, `**/__pycache__`. Excluded files never get marks from typing, mark commands or folder marking. Marks they already have are hidden but kept. Set this in the workspace settings to make it project-wide.

patina.storageFile.description: Where marks are stored, relative to each workspace folder.
